subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should session dashboards become a new core gateway and per-agent persistent-state domain now, with an explicit long-term contract for HTML capability grants and MCP-app rendering?
rationale: The branch adds public gateway RPCs, agent tools, stored session state, and sandboxed-content behavior; deciding the durable product and protocol boundary exceeds a mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Sponsor the core dashboard domain
options.body: Approve the direction contingent on fixing the approval, MCP-app rendering, and read-side storage-creation defects before merge.

options.title: Narrow to a smaller primitive
options.body: Land only a generic board storage or protocol seam and defer widget execution and MCP-app presentation until their owner contracts are settled.

options.title: Keep dashboards outside core
options.body: Route the dashboard implementation through an external plugin or app surface if core ownership is not intended.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core dashboard domain
recommendation.body: Approve the direction contingent on fixing the approval, MCP-app rendering, and read-side storage-creation defects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed owner across the landed board UI foundation and this proposed companion domain.
